01 / ROTO

Tools at your cursor

Open spline and paint options with backtick. Hold Shift to apply multiple choices. W_Hotbox integration is optional.

From sample to Crop

Draw a Viewer sample rectangle, then create a disconnected Crop node from the AjTools menu.

One place for your tools

Get up and running

Install once.
Find it in AjTools.

Works in interactive Nuke 16+ with PySide6. This initial release still needs validation in your Nuke environment.

Download SHA-256 checksum ↗
  1. Download and unzip the release.
  2. Copy the enclosed folder to ~/.nuke/Aj_Tools.
  3. Append the lines below to your existing ~/.nuke/init.py.
  4. Restart Nuke. Open AjTools → AJ Tools Manager….
import nuke
nuke.pluginAddPath('./Aj_Tools')

Updates: use “Install AJ Tools ZIP…” in the manager. Existing AJ Tools files are backed up before replacement.
